scope: Control Plane Center Cut reconciliation negative-path test compilation
rootCause: Two negative-path Mockito verifications use untyped any() for the second JdbcTemplate.update argument. Spring JDBC exposes both PreparedStatementSetter and Object... overloads, so Java 25 compilation cannot select the production Object[] contract.
actualError: reference to update is ambiguous at CenterCutReconciliationControllerTest lines 61 and 129
requiredFix: Type both matchers as Object[] so the tests continue verifying no invocation of the exact production varargs overload.
prohibited: Do not delete the negative assertions, suppress compilation, or change production JDBC behavior to fit a matcher.

sourceFix.implementation: Both negative verifications target any(Object[].class); production code is unchanged.
